name: cloudflare-os
description: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company's context and systems.
one_liner: An open-source 'company AI workspace' where employees can ask an AI to write documents, build small internal apps, and run tasks, with built-in safety guardrails so IT doesn't have to worry about data leaking.
buyer: A head of IT or engineering at a mid-size company who wants to give the whole company safe access to AI agents and internal app-building, without each department adopting random unsanctioned AI tools.
business_use_cases: An IT department deploys it company-wide as the sanctioned way for non-technical staff to build internal tools and automate reports with AI, instead of shadow-IT spreadsheets and scripts.
A sales team uses it to auto-generate slide decks and dashboards for each account, pulling from company context and CRM data.
A consulting firm forks and rebrands it as a client-specific 'Company OS' and resells setup and customization as a service.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid implementation and customization service: set up and white-label a 'YourCompany OS' for mid-size businesses who don't have the engineering time to do it themselves.
Run a managed hosting tier with extra integrations and support, since the open-source version requires real Cloudflare expertise to deploy well.

steal_this: This weekend, deploy it for a small company, wire up one real integration like Google Docs or GitHub, and pitch the setup plus ongoing support as a paid package.
